integrity: The stated quartic identities and finite coefficient census are reproducible from the included standalone Python program; the weighted-quotient proof is algebraic and finite counts are corroborative only. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for cyclic covers preserving the cubic deck action and the distinguished ramification point, not all abstract isomorphism classes.
Coarse rational points are not counts of arithmetic twists.
p-rank zero does not imply supersingularity; no full Newton polygon is asserted.
The Cartier matrix and the a-number-one conclusion have earlier literature precedent; originality is assigned only to the complete geometric rank-zero torus and its boundary.
An unindexed equivalent moduli treatment remains possible.
title: The rank-zero Picard-cover divisor in characteristic five is a one-dimensional torus
